title: Route Pi deployment work through agy-flash
action: Add team.pi.deploy to .bee/config.json as a herding slot that names the existing agy-flash agent and describes approved release work.
verify: .bee/bin/bee team show --runtime pi --json | jq -e 'any(.runtimes[0].roles[]; .role == "deploy" and .transport == "herding: agy-flash" and .description == "publish an approved release from main, wait for CI, and verify release assets")'
